Core mission: 
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Cryogenic fluids are at the heart of our activities: without them, it would not be possible to conduct experiments at very low temperatures and high magnetic fields. We are looking for a technician who will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery - an activity with scientific, economic and environmental implications. The technician will also help to design our future cryogenic systems.

Your tasks:
You will join the team of the Services for Advanced Neutron Environments, where you will be responsible for cryogenic fluid distribution and helium recovery. In this role, you will:
- Perform regular checks to ensure that the distribution and recovery systems are working properly.
- Perform maintenance and regulatory requalification of equipment, and upgrade measurement electronics.
- Produce monthly reports on helium consumption and recovery.
- You will also participate, from time to time, in the design and construction of cryogenic systems.

Your profile:
- You have a Level 5 qualification (NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND, foundation degree or equivalent) in physical measurements.
- You are proficient in the use of spreadsheets and web applications, as well as embedded electronics, and have some knowledge of mechanical engineering.
- You are a strong team player with an inquiring mind and a meticulous approach to your work. A service-oriented attitude and strong interpersonal skills would be highly appreciated.
- You are interested in developing unique devices, are keen to work in a multicultural environment, and enjoy tackling technical challenges.
- You are proficient in English, the working language in our international environment.

What we offer: 
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Job Description: 

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.

As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. 

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    

 Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 

Your challenges:

We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide. 

 We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach : 
 one based in Mobile (USA) 
 one based in Bangalore (India) 

The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation. 

 Your main tasks and responsibilities are: 

Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).  

 Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.  

 Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG). 

 This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills. 

 Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. 

After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. 

Your boarding pass:

You have an advanced level in English. 

 You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. 

You have structure and systems skills. 

 You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics. 

 You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus. 

 You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. 

This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities. 

 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 

 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

The company
The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

About the position
As an experiment support and instrument technician, you will be responsible for the operation and development of experimental equipment and for providing support for experiments conducted at the ILL.
You will work closely with the scientists in charge of the instruments you will be assigned to. You will also collaborate with the other technicians in the Spectroscopy group. You will act as technical contact for the instrument WASP within this group. Depending on the needs of the different groups, you may be asked to work in parallel on other instruments within the Spectroscopy group.

Your tasks
Your main duties will involve the following:
-    Performing maintenance work and repairs on instruments and their ancillary equipment
-    Assisting in-house and visiting scientists with the preparation of their experiments
-    Designing new equipment in collaboration with ILL scientists and technical support groups
-    Improving the instruments and the way in which experiments are conducted by devising innovative technical solutions
-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
-    Installing, maintaining and operating sample environment equipment (cryostats, furnaces, etc.)
-    Organising the purchase of new equipment and spare parts

Desired profile
-    You have a Level 4/5 qualification (e.g. NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND or equivalent) in mechanical, maintenance or electronic engineering.
-    You have experience in the assembly and alignment of precision mechanical assemblies.
-    You have knowledge of CAD software.
-    Experience in scientific instrumentation, in particular in the field of cryogenics, would be an advantage.
-    You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL).

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. Context
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
Within the Industrial Liaison Unit (ILU, 2 people) of ILL's Applied Science Group (18 people), you will act as an effective and efficient interface between industry and the cutting-edge neutron techniques and scientists available at the ILL for proprietary research and development (R&D) as well as non-destructive testing (NDT).

Your tasks
In this context, you will:
. Organise and perform efficient and successful proprietary R&D and NDT utilising ILL's neutron instruments, working closely with instrument scientists and industry clients.
. Build up expertise in neutron techniques and operating instruments relevant to industrial R&D and NDT opportunities.
. Contribute to a strategy to increase industrial R&D and NDT activity at ILL, to maximise revenue from this activity (currently around 0.5 M? per year).
. Undertake outreach and communication activities for industrial R&D/NDT at ILL to build up a portfolio of high-potential industry contacts and generate new business opportunities.
. Manage the customer base and maintain an accurate record of all industry-related activities at ILL for periodic reporting and review for optimisation of ILL's industry strategy with Management.
. With support from the legal service at ILL, organise the contractual agreements for proprietary beam time.
. With ILL's Grants Office, your line manager and relevant ILL scientists, identify and pursue project-based opportunities for industry-related research at ILL.
. Liaise with local, regional and international partners to nurture a robust, collective approach to industry services at large-scale research facilities.

Your profile
. You hold a PhD in engineering or a natural science (or equivalent qualification) and have several years of experience in a range of analytical techniques, preferably using neutrons.
. You have excellent communication skills, are highly interested in applied research and have some experience in working with industry / R&D / NDT.
. You have a strong project management culture, which will enable you to plan and manage the ILL's involvement in R&D and NDT with industry partners.

jobs.occupation: Technicien / Technicienne de maintenance en matériels informatiqu (H/F)
jobs.description:
Role Requirements & Responsibilities :

Field Execution and Technical Delivery :
- Attend client sites on time with all required equipment, PPE, documentation, and job readiness.
- Lead complex fibre and copper cabling installations across multi-rack, multi-room, or multi-phase deployments.
- Execute structured cabling tasks including routing, termination, dressing, patching, and cross-connects in live data centre environments.
- Validate job readiness before execution including materials, access approvals, drawings, risk assessments, and site conditions.
- Provide technical input into daily task sequencing and execution planning in coordination with Supervisors.
- Resolve non-standard field issues and implement corrective actions in line with customer standards.
- Ensure all installations follow approved methodologies, design documentation, and safety requirements..

Quality, Testing, and Documentation:
- Validate cable routing, dressing, labeling, and patching accuracy during and after execution.
- Support preparation, execution, and review of fibre and copper testing activities.
- Review test outputs and highlight deviations or quality risks to Supervisors.
- Maintain accurate cable schedules, as-built documentation, and task reporting.
- Identify quality gaps and initiate corrective actions in coordination with Supervisors and Project Leads.

Team Support and Coordination :
- Provide technical guidance and support to field teams during complex tasks.
- Act as technical escalation point for on-site cabling issues.
- Communicate progress, risks, and constraints clearly to Supervisors and Project Leads.
- Represent professionally in all customer-facing site interactions.

Safety and Compliance :
- Ensure compliance with all customer health, safety, and security procedures.
- Identify and escalate safety risks or non-compliant practices immediately.
- Support safety briefings and on-site adherence to operational rules..

 The role requires flexibility and adaptability to changing situations and customer requirements, so the candidate must be comfortable working under pressure and on strict timelines. The candidate must be adaptable while performing tasks, ready to change priorities and maintain professional communications with clients, colleagues and vendors.

The successful candidate will be required to possess and demonstrate the following:
- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills with high levels of attention to detail.
- Prior experience with the installation of structured cabling including fibre and copper.
- Strong understanding of structured cabling standards, pathways, and installation methodologies.
- Experience working in live data centre environments.
- Valid class B driving licence with a good driving record where travel is required.
- Basic experience with hand and power tools.
- Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, and Email.
- Language proficiency at minimum B1 level in English.
- Proficiency in another European language would be advantageous..
The following qualifications, skills and experience would be an advantage.
- Minimum 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in data centre cabling operations.
- Strong troubleshooting capability across fibre, copper, containment, and rack environments.
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, patching matrices, and test documentation.
- Demonstrated ability to lead field execution technically without formal line management.
- Experience mentoring junior technicians.
- Ability to travel for work across customer sites.

Join a team that keeps the world's digital infrastructure running. Every project makes a difference !
